description: A model's response as submitted to the record. The bytes are a detached object at contentRef; identical bytes are one object, and this artifact's name is the hash of this spec.

claims: the bytes at contentRef were submitted as a model's response by the recorded actor at the recorded position on the chain
doesNotClaim: that any tool call inside them ran
that the recorded actor held the key whose fingerprint is recorded — admissions are not yet signed by their actors
